video.title: Fantasy Basketball Points League Mock Draft [Yahoo Scoring]

summary: Josh Lloyd runs a 12-team Yahoo points league mock draft with a third-round reversal, picking 10th. He stresses again and again that points leagues value players differently from category leagues, and he makes several picks only because of the format: Paolo Banchero, Stephon Castle and Jalen Green. His roster is Anthony Edwards, Karl-Anthony Towns, Banchero, Dejounte Murray, Castle, Dyson Daniels, Onyeka Okongwu, Jarrett Allen, Collin Murray-Boyles, Jaxson Hayes (said as "Yakel", name uncertain), Jakob Poeltl, Ace Bailey, Grayson Allen and Isaiah Jackson. He criticises early picks such as Tyrese Haliburton at 9, Kevin Durant and Paul George. He calls Tyrese Maxey and Dyson Daniels values. He flags injury news on Nurkic, Claxton and Coby White, and role uncertainty in Milwaukee, Phoenix, New Orleans and San Antonio. On his own Basketball Monster projections, his team projects first.

rules.text: Draft for your format. Some players are worth much more in points leagues than in category leagues, and the reverse is also true.
rules.quote: You would never do this in a category league at this spot, but he's got top 15 points league upside

rules.text: Know your league type before you draft. Picking for categories in a points league is a common mistake.
rules.quote: But again, understanding your draft. At some point, I might just chuck a little message in the chat.

rules.text: From about rounds 10 to 11, take flyers: players with upside, not safe picks with a low ceiling.
rules.quote: So he's really taking the flyer stuff to heart at round 10, which it can be round 10, round 11.

rules.text: If your roster is not risky, you can afford a risky swing in the middle rounds.
rules.quote: My team is not that risky that I could take an ED swing in round seven.

rules.text: In leagues with daily lineup changes, avoid stashing an injured player for a long time. He wastes a roster spot.
rules.quote: That's just again in a daily changes format. I I can't see how it works out.

rules.text: When a starter gets hurt, his cheap backup can give early-season value.
rules.quote: can just get a little bit of value early on with Claxton injured.

rules.text: Picking several players from the team you support is a bias trap.
rules.quote: Warriors fan. Taking those guys together is craziness.

rules.text: Late in drafts, scroll past the default list on the board to find players you actually want.
rules.quote: So, you just got to make sure you're scroll scrolling through to find guys you actually want to take here.
